content.text: Skip to Main ContentComingNovember 192026PlayStation 5Xbox Series X|SVice City, USA.Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.Jason DuvalJason wants an easy life, but things just keep getting harder.Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled teens, he found himself in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners. It might be time to try something new.If anything happens, I'm right behind you.Another day in paradise, right?Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him.
